CancellationofExtraordinaryGeneralMeeting
Thisistoinformyou thattheBoardofDirectorsof Ghani GlassLimited hasdecidednot
to increase the authorized capital of the company and withdraw/cancel the Notice of
Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled to be held on June 19, 2023 and deferred
other agenda items of aforesaid EOGM to the next general meeting of the company. The
Book Closure determined for EOGM from June 13, 2023 to June 19, 2023 stand
cancelled.
Thesamenoticewillbepublishedinnewspaperstomorrow.
You may please inform the TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly
Yours truly,
